title: Daily Parabolic SAR 0.02/0.02/0.20 full-capital long/cash trend reversal
thesis: A path-dependent Parabolic SAR stop that accelerates toward each BTC trend extreme may exit deteriorating trends faster than a slow moving average while remaining invested through persistent advances, preserving material after-cost upside and improving drawdown and Calmar versus continuous BTC ownership.
mechanism: Compute original-style PSAR from complete UTC-day highs, lows and closes using start 0.02, increment 0.02 and maximum 0.20. Hold full BTC when the PSAR state is bullish and zero-yield cash when bearish, executing changed targets at the next H1 open.
economic_rationale: The acceleration factor should tighten the reversal threshold as a trend ages without using a fixed lookback mean. It is useful only if the official primary preserves material upside, improves risk-adjusted performance, survives annual breadth and remains non-fragile at rejection-only 0.01 and 0.03 acceleration neighbors.
